The empirical branch gives the first upper bound, the inherited u branch gives the second, and the baseline lower is at least 1/n. Update prop:empirical-mass-collision-region to state this union; update def:residual-wedge to require u_{n,d}>1/n in addition to its current exclusions; synchronize oeq:repair-benchmark-prior and TLDR/honest-scope/project prose so no already-closed points are advertised as open.
